summary: All 45 rows' cited evidence exists and the numbers quoted match the committed r4*.json; I re-ran r4a, r4b, r4c, r4c2, r4d, r4e, r4f in a scratch mirror under the 1500M cap and every output json was byte-identical, then probed neighbours (1e-2..1e5 scale, 25%-edge gate, sliver, signed distY, angle, redundant, 1e-7/1e-10 near-conflicts) without finding a silent wrong solid. One major status inconsistency (overConstrained flag row) and several minors; no blocking defect.

defects.feature: solveSketch result: overConstrained flag (residual > 1e-3), legacy outline solver
defects.problem: Status is supported but its own evidence shows wrong reports: 5/400 satisfiable sets flagged over-constrained, 2/400 infeasible sets not flagged (residual up to 6.06e-4), and at 1e5 scale 28/40 satisfiable rectangles are flagged because the threshold is absolute. Row 'degenerate inputs and scale' (index 42) marks the same flag wrong, so the two rows disagree; the flag is also what makes the shipped script path drop a rule.

defects.feature: solveSketchDrag: the dragged corner is pinned at the pointer
defects.problem: Supported, yet 0/100 drags leave the written rules held (worst violation up to 1.8 mm) and the next solve moves the corner back a median 4.9 mm; the student sees a rule-violating sketch mid-drag. Called 'designed behaviour' without a UI check.

defects.problem: Supported with 2 of 64 bucket disagreements vs the FreeCAD refs (sk-conflict__horizontal-and-vertical reported consistent by dof route, collapsed by the guard); safe only because the collapse refusal catches it.
